evals.title: Patient overview
evals.prompt: Build the first screen of a longitudinal synthetic patient chart with allergies, conditions, medications, results, notes and tasks.
evals.expected_output: Patient-context-first overview with prioritized current/action-driving information and detail on demand.
assertions: Persistent patient context remains visible during review and action.
Current, historical and pending states are visually distinguishable.
Values retain units and timestamps where relevant.
No-data, not-recorded and not-loaded states are not conflated.
Chronology and provenance are understandable.
The first viewport is not dominated by decorative or AI summary content.
